title: Content Signal Report
description: Predicted social-media virality signal for a finished short-form render, produced by the Meta TRIBE v2 brain-encoding model hosted on Replicate (prakhar-bhartiya/meta-tribev2-social-media-content-signal). ADVISORY ONLY: this score never gates publishing. Field names mirror the model's verified output schema.

model_version.description: Model's reported model_version (or the Replicate version id)

video_sha256.description: Content hash of the scored render; cache key (model is deterministic)

video_duration_s.description: Duration the model reported for the scored video

sub_scores.description: Brain-region-mapped subscores (typically reward, emotion, attention, social_relevance, novelty). Keys are taken verbatim from the model output.

timeline.description: Per-step subscores over time (~2Hz), verbatim from the model. Each element is a flat object of numbers.

cache_hit.description: True when returned from the content-hash cache (no new paid call)

advisory.description: Always true. This score is advisory and never blocks publishing.

raw_output.description: Verbatim Replicate model output, kept for audit and re-parse.
